# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Scaffold demo project (csproj + config) with offline-safe defaults
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo.csproj` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/appsettings.json` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/appsettings.secrets.json.example` (new)
  - Implement:
    - Create a new console demo project targeting `net10.0`
    - Reference:
      - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Abstractions`
      - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.LLMTornado`
    - Ensure demo assets are copied to output:
      - `runner/**/*`, `plugins/**/*`, `demo_project/**/*`, `README.md`, `appsettings*.json`
    - Provide two provider configs in `LLMProviders.Providers`:
      - `claude_agent_sdk_minimal` (allowedTools empty)
      - `claude_agent_sdk_full` (allowedTools includes read/write)
    - Keep all config offline-safe (no real endpoint required; no secrets committed)
  - Purpose: Make the demo runnable with `dotnet run` and keep resources available under `AppContext.BaseDirectory`
  - _Leverage: `examples/LlmTornadoDemo/LlmTornadoDemo.csproj` (CopyToOutput patterns), `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Abstractions/Configuration/LLMProviderConfig.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 4, 5, 6, 7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: .NET demo author | Task: Add the demo project scaffold (csproj + appsettings) for Claude Agent SDK provider, ensuring offline-safe defaults and that runner/plugins/.claude assets are copied to output. | Restrictions: No secrets committed; no external network calls; no port 5000; keep files minimal and consistent with other `examples/*Demo`. | _Leverage: examples/LlmTornadoDemo patterns | _Requirements: 1,4,5,6,7 | Success: `dotnet build` succeeds and the output folder contains the demo assets ready for the next tasks. (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)

- [ ] 2. Implement mock Claude Agent SDK runner (Node, no deps) with marker protocol
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/runner/mock_claude_agent_sdk_runner.mjs` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/runner/README.md` (new)
  - Implement:
    - Read one JSON request from stdin (matching provider payload shape)
    - Read `.claude` config from `projectRoot/.claude/demo_settings.json` (best-effort)
    - Load plugins from provided `plugins` paths (best-effort; failure should be explicit)
    - Enforce `allowedTools`:
      - Deny `filesystem_read` / `filesystem_write` unless explicitly allowed
    - Output markers:
      - `AEVATAR_AGENT_SDK_STREAM:{text}` (if `stream=true`)
      - `AEVATAR_AGENT_SDK_OUTPUT:{json}` (always; include `{ "content": "..." }`)
    - Keep deterministic output (no randomness; no network)
  - Purpose: Provide an offline, reproducible process-based runner demonstrating `.claude` + plugins + permission gating + streaming markers
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.LLMTornado/ClaudeAgentSdk/ClaudeAgentSdkProtocol.cs` (marker contract)_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Node.js systems engineer | Task: Create a dependency-free mock runner that reads stdin JSON, optionally streams via markers, reads `.claude` settings, loads plugins, enforces allowedTools, and emits a final JSON output marker. | Restrictions: Node builtin modules only (fs/path/url); no network; no secrets; deterministic output; do not bind any ports (and do not mention :5000). | _Leverage: ClaudeAgentSdkProtocol marker strings | _Requirements: 1-6 | Success: Running `node mock_claude_agent_sdk_runner.mjs < request.json` prints valid markers, with observable differences when plugins/allowedTools/.claude are present. (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)

- [ ] 3. Add demo plugins (deterministic transforms)
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/plugins/plugin_uppercase.mjs` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/plugins/plugin_append_tag.mjs` (new)
  - Implement:
    - Each plugin exports `transform(text, ctx)` and returns transformed text
    - Deterministic: no randomness, no file I/O, no network
  - Purpose: Show plugin loading and composability (visible output differences)
  - _Leverage: Runner plugin contract defined in `runner/mock_claude_agent_sdk_runner.mjs`_
  - _Requirements: 3, 6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Node.js plugin author | Task: Add two minimal ESM plugins implementing `transform(text, ctx)` that produce easy-to-see deterministic output transformations. | Restrictions: No network, no fs writes; keep plugins tiny and readable. | _Leverage: runner plugin loading contract | _Requirements: 3,6 | Success: Runner loads plugins and output clearly changes (e.g., uppercase + appended tag). (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)

- [ ] 4. Add demo project assets (`.claude`, data, output dir)
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/demo_project/.claude/demo_settings.json` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/demo_project/data/context.txt` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/demo_project/output/.gitkeep` (new)
  - Implement:
    - `.claude` sample config contains a persona/strategy field that the runner will echo into output
    - `context.txt` provides sample content for permission-gated `filesystem_read`
    - `output/` is the only allowed write target for demo (permission-gated `filesystem_write`)
  - Purpose: Make `.claude` and permission gating tangible and reproducible
  - _Leverage: Existing repo convention: keep demo assets under `examples/*Demo/` and copy to output via csproj_
  - _Requirements: 2, 4, 6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Demo content designer | Task: Add minimal `.claude` config + context data + an output directory placeholder to support the runner’s `.claude` reading and allowedTools-gated filesystem read/write demos. | Restrictions: Keep contents small and non-sensitive; no secrets; output dir must stay inside demo folder. | _Requirements: 2,4,6 | Success: Runner can read `.claude` and context.txt when allowed, and can write a generated file into demo_project/output when allowed. (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)

- [ ] 5. Implement demo app: compare baseline vs `claude_agent_sdk` (minimal/full) + streaming
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/Program.cs` (new)
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/BaselineDeterministicProvider.cs` (new)
  - Implement:
    - Build DI host like other examples:
      - `services.Configure<LLMProvidersConfig>(config.GetSection("LLMProviders"))`
      - `services.AddAevatarLLMTornado()`
    - Create 3 runs with the same logical input:
      - Baseline provider (in-process, deterministic; does not read `.claude` or plugins)
      - `claude_agent_sdk_minimal` (allowedTools empty → demonstrate denial)
      - `claude_agent_sdk_full` (allowedTools read/write → demonstrate enabled capabilities)
    - Streaming demo:
      - Call `GenerateStreamAsync` for `claude_agent_sdk_full` and print token deltas incrementally
    - Tool-loop boundary demo:
      - Include a dummy `request.Functions` and print that `claude_agent_sdk` path never returns `AevatarFunctionCall`
    - After `full` run, verify the runner wrote a file under `demo_project/output/` and print the path
    - If `node` is missing, catch and print a clear remediation hint
  - Purpose: One command run shows the unique benefits and boundaries of Claude Agent SDK provider
  - _Leverage: `examples/LlmTornadoDemo/Program.cs` (Host+DI pattern), `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.LLMTornado/docs/ClaudeAgentSdkProvider.Advantages.md`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: .NET framework demo engineer | Task: Build the console demo that constructs requests, runs baseline vs claude_agent_sdk (minimal/full), prints streaming output, and explains differences (claude projectRoot/.claude, plugins, permissions, process isolation). Ensure no network is required. | Restrictions: Do not rely on current working directory; compute absolute paths from `AppContext.BaseDirectory`; do not mention/use port 5000; keep output readable and deterministic. | _Leverage: ILLMProviderFactory from AddAevatarLLMTornado, ClaudeAgentSdkProvider docs | _Requirements: 1-7 | Success: `dotnet run` prints three clearly separated sections + a streaming section, and shows an on-disk output file created only when allowedTools includes filesystem_write. (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)

- [ ] 6. Write demo README (how to run + what to look for + how to swap to real runner)
  - Files:
    - `examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo/README.md` (new)
  - Include:
    - Prereqs: `dotnet` + `node` (for mock runner); what happens if missing
    - Run steps: `cd examples/ClaudeAgentSdkProviderDemo && dotnet run`
    - What the output demonstrates (mapping to requirements 2-6)
    - How to replace mock runner with a real Claude Agent SDK runner script (without committing secrets)
    - Security + port policy reminder (no listening; avoid `:5000`, suggest `:5678` only for future sidecar)
  - Purpose: Make the demo self-explanatory and useful as onboarding material
  - _Leverage: `examples/LlmTornadoDemo/README.md` style, `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.LLMTornado/docs/ClaudeAgentSdkProvider.md`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec claude-agent-sdk-provider-demo, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Technical writer | Task: Add a concise README for the demo explaining how to run it, what capabilities are being demonstrated, and how to swap the mock runner for a real Claude Agent SDK runner safely. | Restrictions: No secrets; no port 5000; keep steps copy-pastable. | _Leverage: existing example READMEs + ClaudeAgentSdkProvider docs | _Requirements: 1,7 | Success: A new developer can run the demo and understand the differentiators in <10 minutes. (Workflow: mark task [-] in tasks.md before coding; after completion use log-implementation with artifacts; then mark [x].)
